title: cyclosorus latifolius
intro: Cyclosorus latifolius, commonly known as the Chinese ladder brake, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus latifolius include its ability to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
